token_basis: Explicit future workload estimate for a multi-task household request, not the observed benchmark average. 500 output tokens follows the architecture lead's provisional assumption. Person 3 must use the same workload and inclusion scope before API comparison.

cloud.configuration: 1x RTX 3090 Pod, published listing; region not specified on public price page
cloud.price_status: Public advertised rate checked 2026-10-24; no region-specific capacity reservation or purchase quote obtained. No spot/commitment discount assumed.

capacity.hardware_transfer_status: ASSUMPTION, not measured on RTX 3090; not claimed to be a guaranteed conservative bound.
capacity.reference_condition: T4, NF4, FP32 compute, eager attention, batch 1, greedy, 220-token cap
capacity.other_models: Log-linear interpolation of four Person 2 parameter-count/TPS anchors. Below minimum uses minimum anchor rate; above maximum scales largest-anchor rate inversely by parameter count. These 11 rates are estimates, not benchmark results.
capacity.memory_status: FP16-sized weight budget plus 8 decimal GB runtime/KV headroom is a planning fit check for one resident model and short batch-1 contexts, not a measured allocator peak or proof of all-model quantization compatibility. Actual target serving condition is NF4.

inclusions: 24-hour always-on inference Pod compute including listed CPU/RAM
20 GB container disk and 80 GB running volume per replica
thin request handler co-hosted on the inference Pod; 25% service-time penalty
exclusions: shared Django/frontend/database baseline, common to both alternatives
load balancers, backups, monitoring, labor, taxes, redundancy and enterprise support
idle/stopped storage billing and initial download/warmup
additional capacity for a latency SLA or multi-region availability
comparison_rule: An inference-tier scenario, not full production TCO. Person 3 API total must include its required API gateway compute/storage under this same scope; shared platform and the explicitly excluded categories must be treated identically. Do not claim local/API crossover until the 90 API rows have matching assumptions and boundaries.
